# infoblox_next_available_address_blocks (Data Source)

Retrieves the next available address blocks in the specified address block. Only applicable for the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
data "infoblox_next_available_address_blocks" "by_id" {
  id                  = "ipam/address_block/9f9675a2-6ad1-11f1-8248-6ad7b099fb40"
  cidr                = 24
  address_block_count = 3
}

data "infoblox_next_available_address_blocks" "by_tags" {
  cidr                = 24
  address_block_count = 3
  tag_filters = {
    environment = "production"
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (Number) The cidr value of address blocks to be created.

### Optional

- `address_block_count` (Number) Number of address blocks to generate. Default 1 if not set.
- `id` (String) An application specific resource identity of a resource.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Key-value pairs to filter address blocks by tags.

### Read-Only

- `results` (List of String) List of next available address block's addresses in the specified resource.
